Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Vivek Kumar Sinha, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Raj Kishor Singh, APP.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 24-12-2025 Heard learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner who happens to be husband of the opposite party no. 2 apprehending his arrest in connection with Nawada Complaint Case No. 636 of 2023, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. At the outset, learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that the marriage was solemnized in the year 2015, however on account of instigation by some unscrupulous person, the present Complaint Case has been filed, wherein Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.85326 of 2025(2) dt.24-12-2025 cognizance has been taken for the offence punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

It is specific contention of the learned Advocate for the petitioner that the petitioner has always been ready to keep the opposite party no. 2, but it is she who does not want to live in the matrimonial home.

4. On the other hand, learned Advocate for the State vehemently opposed the pre-arrest bail application and submits that there is complete latches on the part of the petitioner who was evading his arrest, though the cognizance was taken on 29.08.2023 itself.
5.

Be that as it may, considering the fact that the dispute has arisen on account of a matrimonial discord, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2 under both registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, the requisite of which must be filed within a period of two weeks, from today.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.85326 of 2025(2) dt.24-12-2025 6.
Re - notify this case immediately after valid service of notice or on appearance of the opposite party no. 2 or on 04.02.2026, whichever is earlier.
7. In the meantime, let there shall be no coercive action against the petitioner, till further order.
